title: Letters of cipher text examined per second by the Tunny-breaking machines
description: Bar chart, letters examined per second: Heath Robinson, 1,000 to 2,000 (2,000 at best, on short tapes); Colossus Mark 1, 5,000; Colossus Mark 2, 5,000 read and, with five processors testing five positions at once, an effective 25,000. Data: General Report on Tunny (1945), sections 53B and 54C; Wikipedia, Colossus computer, revision cited.
heading: LETTERS EXAMINED PER SECOND
